heroHeadline: Chinese Military Activity Near US Ally in South China Sea Nearly Doubles, New Report Finds
heroSubtitle: A new report reveals Chinese military activity around a key US ally in disputed South China Sea waters has nearly doubled, sharply raising regional tensions and underscoring escalating pressure on US alliance commitments in the Spratlys.
